changelog: Cybernetic & Obsidian Armor Themes: Rebuilt design system around AntiBot signature obsidian armor, electric cyan visor, and neon accents with 6 unique themes
Single-Card Floating UX: Streamlined input container unifying multiline text, attachments preview, queued messages, and quick actions
Remote Server Mode & SSH Tunneling: Connect to remote host over SSH or direct TCP with auto-reconnecting port forwarding and profile switching
Termux:X11 Desktop Manager: Run Linux graphical apps, window managers, and desktops with one tap directly inside AntiBot
GitHub CLI & Git Workspace: Sign in via gh CLI, clone, manage repositories, and inspect remotes
APK Size Reduction: Streamlined from 44MB to ~13.4MB using XZ compression, arm64 ABI filter, and optimized release shrinking
In-App Changelog & Dynamic IDE: Live 'What\'s new' changelog screen and theme-matched code editor
